passageTitle: Questions 147-148 refer to the following coupon.
passageHtml:
SUNNY PETALS FLOWER SHOP

25% OFF ANY BOUQUET

Valid on roses, lilies, and birthday flower boxes.

Show this coupon at our shop: 88 River Road

Good until May 31. One coupon per customer.

questions.q: What does Sunny Petals Flower Shop offer with this coupon?
questions.translation: Cửa hàng hoa Sunny Petals ưu đãi gì với phiếu giảm giá này?
questions.explanation: Trên phiếu ghi rõ '25% OFF ANY BOUQUET' (Giảm 25% cho bất kỳ bó hoa nào).

questions.q: When does the coupon expire?
questions.translation: Phiếu giảm giá hết hạn khi nào?
questions.explanation: Dòng cuối ghi 'Good until May 31' (Có giá trị đến hết ngày 31 tháng 5).

passageTitle: Questions 149-151 refer to the following text message.
passageHtml:
Text Message — Delivery Alert

From: FastBox Delivery (9:15 A.M.)

Hello Ms. Nguyen. Your package from City Book Store is out for delivery today. Our driver, Sam, will arrive at your office between 1:00 P.M. and 3:00 P.M.

Please reply YES if someone will be at the front desk to sign for the box. If no one is there, we can leave it in Locker 4.

questions.q: What is inside the package?
questions.translation: Bên trong bưu kiện có gì?
questions.explanation: Tin nhắn ghi 'Your package from City Book Store' (Bưu kiện của bạn từ Hiệu sách City).

questions.q: When will the driver arrive?
questions.translation: Tài xế sẽ đến vào lúc nào?
questions.explanation: Tin nhắn nêu 'Sam, will arrive at your office between 1:00 P.M. and 3:00 P.M.'

questions.q: Where can the driver put the box if no one is at the front desk?
questions.translation: Tài xế có thể đặt hộp ở đâu nếu không có ai ở quầy lễ tân?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối ghi 'If no one is there, we can leave it in Locker 4.'

passageTitle: Questions 152-154 refer to the following notice.
passageHtml:
NOTICE: Temporary Water Shut-Off

Building: Greenview Apartments

Date: Friday, July 14

Time: 10:00 A.M. to 1:00 P.M.

Plumbers will replace an old water pipe on the first floor. During these three hours, there will be no cold or hot water in any apartment.

Please fill some bottles with water before 10:00 A.M. We are sorry for the trouble.

questions.q: Why will the water be turned off?
options: To replace an old water pipe
questions.translation: Tại sao nước sẽ bị cắt?
questions.explanation: Thông báo ghi 'Plumbers will replace an old water pipe on the first floor.' (Thợ sửa ống nước sẽ thay một ống nước cũ ở tầng một).

questions.q: How long will the water shut-off last?
questions.translation: Việc cắt nước sẽ kéo dài bao lâu?
questions.explanation: Từ 10:00 A.M. đến 1:00 P.M. là 3 tiếng ('During these three hours').

questions.q: What are residents asked to do before 10:00 A.M.?
questions.translation: Cư dân được yêu cầu làm gì trước 10 giờ sáng?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối khuyên 'Please fill some bottles with water before 10:00 A.M.' (Vui lòng hứng đầy một ít chai nước trước 10 giờ sáng).

passageTitle: Questions 155-157 refer to the following schedule.
passageHtml:
HARBOR HISTORY MUSEUM — OPENING HOURS

Saturday – Sunday10:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.

Tickets: Adults $10 | Students $5 | Children under 6: Free

questions.q: On which day is the museum closed?
questions.translation: Bảo tàng đóng cửa vào ngày nào?
questions.explanation: Bảng giờ ghi rõ 'Monday: Closed'.

questions.q: What time does the museum open on Saturday?
questions.translation: Bảo tàng mở cửa lúc mấy giờ vào thứ Bảy?
questions.explanation: Hàng cuối bảng ghi 'Saturday – Sunday: 10:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.'

questions.q: How much does a ticket cost for a student?
questions.translation: Giá vé cho một học sinh/sinh viên là bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: Dòng giá vé ghi 'Students $5'.

passageTitle: Questions 158-160 refer to the following train timetable.
passageHtml:
MORNING TRAINS: CENTRAL STATION TO AIRPORT

TrainDeparts CentralArrives AirportPlatform
#1026:30 A.M.7:05 A.M.Platform 2
#1047:15 A.M.7:50 A.M.Platform 1

*All trains run every day. One-way ticket: $8.

questions.q: Which train leaves Central Station at 7:15 A.M.?
questions.translation: Chuyến tàu nào rời Ga Trung tâm lúc 7 giờ 15 sáng?
questions.explanation: Theo bảng giờ, Train #104 khởi hành ('Departs Central') lúc 7:15 A.M.

questions.q: Where does Train #106 leave from?
questions.translation: Chuyến tàu #106 khởi hành từ sân ga nào?
questions.explanation: Hàng cuối bảng ghi Train #106 ở 'Platform 3'.

questions.q: How long is the train ride from Central Station to the Airport?
questions.translation: Chuyến tàu từ Ga Trung tâm đến Sân bay mất bao lâu?
questions.explanation: Ví dụ chuyến #102 đi lúc 6:30 A.M. và đến lúc 7:05 A.M., tổng thời gian là 35 phút.

passageTitle: Questions 161-163 refer to the following job advertisement.
passageHtml:
HELP WANTED: Part-Time Cashier

Fresh Market Grocery is looking for a friendly part-time cashier.

  • Hours: Saturdays & Sundays, 1:00 P.M. – 7:00 P.M.
  • Pay: $14 per hour
  • Duties: Scan groceries, take payments, and bag items.

No experience is needed. We will train you! Call Mr. Gomez at 555-0148 to set up a short interview.

questions.q: What job is Fresh Market Grocery offering?
questions.translation: Cửa hàng Fresh Market Grocery đang tuyển vị trí nào?
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề ghi rõ 'Part-Time Cashier' (Nhân viên thu ngân bán thời gian).

questions.q: How much does the job pay per hour?
questions.translation: Công việc này trả bao nhiêu tiền mỗi giờ?
questions.explanation: Mục Pay ghi rõ '$14 per hour'.

questions.q: How should interested people apply?
questions.translation: Những người quan tâm nên ứng tuyển bằng cách nào?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối ghi 'Call Mr. Gomez at 555-0148 to set up a short interview.'

passageTitle: Questions 164-166 refer to the following rules.
passageHtml:
FITLIFE GYM — MEMBER RULES

  1. Always scan your member card at the front desk.
  2. Wear clean sports shoes inside the workout area.
  3. Wipe down machines with a towel after using them.
  4. Do not bring food into the gym. Water bottles are okay.
  5. Put all weights back on the racks when you finish.

Thank you for keeping FitLife Gym clean and safe!

questions.q: What must members show at the front desk?
questions.translation: Hội viên phải xuất trình gì tại quầy lễ tân?
questions.explanation: Quy tắc số 1 ghi 'Always scan your member card at the front desk.'

questions.q: What is allowed inside the gym?
questions.translation: Thứ gì được phép mang vào phòng tập?
questions.explanation: Quy tắc số 4 ghi 'Do not bring food into the gym. Water bottles are okay.'

questions.q: Where should members put weights after using them?
questions.translation: Hội viên nên để tạ ở đâu sau khi sử dụng xong?
questions.explanation: Quy tắc số 5 ghi 'Put all weights back on the racks when you finish.'

passageTitle: Questions 167-169 refer to the following receipt.
passageHtml:

questions.q: How much did it cost to dry-clean the winter coat?
questions.translation: Chi phí giặt khô chiếc áo khoác mùa đông là bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: Trên hóa đơn ghi '1 Winter Coat (Dry Clean) ............ $12.00'.

questions.q: How did Mr. Park pay for his laundry?
questions.translation: Ông Park đã thanh toán tiền giặt ủi bằng cách nào?
questions.explanation: Dòng tổng tiền ghi 'Total Paid (Cash): $25.00'.

questions.q: When can Mr. Park pick up his clothes?
questions.translation: Khi nào ông Park có thể đến lấy quần áo?
questions.explanation: Dòng cuối ghi 'Pick-up Date: Saturday, August 5, after 2:00 P.M.'

passageTitle: Questions 170-172 refer to the following invitation.
passageHtml:
Oak City Book Club — Monthly Meeting

Dear Club Members,

You are invited to our next meeting on Thursday, September 21, at 6:30 P.M. We will meet in Room B at the Oak City Public Library.

This month, we will talk about the novel The Quiet Lake by Emma Sato. Tea and cookies will be served.

Feel free to bring a friend! Please e-mail Maya at maya@oakbookclub.org by September 18 if you plan to come.

questions.q: Where will the book club meeting take place?
options: At the Oak City Public Library
questions.translation: Buổi họp câu lạc bộ sách sẽ diễn ra ở đâu?
questions.explanation: Thư mời ghi 'We will meet in Room B at the Oak City Public Library.'

questions.q: What will be served at the meeting?
questions.translation: Đồ ăn thức uống nào sẽ được phục vụ tại buổi họp?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ 'Tea and cookies will be served.'

questions.q: What should members do by September 18?
questions.translation: Các thành viên nên làm gì trước ngày 18 tháng 9?
questions.explanation: Câu cuối yêu cầu 'Please e-mail Maya at maya@oakbookclub.org by September 18 if you plan to come.'

passageTitle: Questions 173-175 refer to the following price list.
passageHtml:
SPARKLE CAR WASH — PRICE LIST

  • Basic Wash (Outside wash & dry): $12
  • Silver Wash (Outside wash + wheel cleaning): $18
  • Gold Wash (Outside wash + wheel cleaning + inside vacuum): $25

Special Deal: Every Tuesday, seniors (age 60+) get $3 off any wash.

Open daily: 8:00 A.M. – 6:00 P.M.

questions.q: How much does a Basic Wash cost?
questions.translation: Gói rửa xe cơ bản (Basic Wash) giá bao nhiêu?
questions.explanation: Dòng đầu danh sách ghi 'Basic Wash (Outside wash & dry): $12'.

questions.q: Which service includes an inside vacuum?
questions.translation: Dịch vụ nào bao gồm hút bụi bên trong xe?
questions.explanation: Mục Gold Wash ghi rõ 'Outside wash + wheel cleaning + inside vacuum'.

questions.q: When can seniors get a $3 discount?
questions.translation: Khi nào người cao tuổi được giảm 3 đô la?
questions.explanation: Mục Special Deal ghi 'Every Tuesday, seniors (age 60+) get $3 off any wash.'
